5. CSS — Styles for Modules

5.1 CSS Variables — the Abcona Design

All colors and spacing come from CSS variables. Never hardcode colors — always use variables, otherwise the dark mode will break.

/* Abcona Blue — Main color of the portal */
--abcona-blue:       #163258;   /* Sidebar, Header, Buttons */
--abcona-blue-dark:  #0f2442;   /* Hover, active elements */
--abcona-blue-light: #1e4a7a;   /* Lighter accents */

/* Backgrounds */
--abcona-gray-bg:    #eef2f5;   /* Page background */
--abcona-gray-card:  #f8fafc;   /* Card background */

/* Status colors */
--status-green:  #10b981;       /* OK, Active, Success */
--status-yellow: #f59e0b;       /* Warning */
--status-red:    #ef4444;       /* Error, Danger */

/* Text */
--text-primary:   #1e1e1e;      /* Main text */
--text-secondary: #6c757d;      /* Secondary text */
--border-color:   #dee2e6;      /* Borders */

/* Layout */
--sidebar-width-expanded:  240px;
--sidebar-width-collapsed: 60px;
--border-radius-card:      12px;

5.2 Dark Mode automatically

When the user activates dark mode, the portal adds the class dark-mode to <body>. All CSS variables are automatically overwritten. No custom dark mode code needed — as long as only variables are used:

/* ✅ Correct — works in Light + Dark */
.my-element {
    background: var(--abcona-gray-card);
    color:      var(--text-primary);
    border:     1px solid var(--border-color);
}

/* ❌ Wrong — breaks in dark mode */
.my-element {
    background: #f8fafc;
    color:      #1e1e1e;
    border:     1px solid #dee2e6;
}

5.3 CSS Class Prefix

All module-specific CSS classes get a short prefix to avoid conflicts:

/* Module: cv_editor → Prefix: cve- */
.cve-container  { ... }
.cve-header     { ... }
.cve-table      { ... }

/* Module: mein_modul → Prefix: mm- */
.mm-container   { ... }
.mm-card        { ... }

5.4 Minimal Module CSS

/* mod-mein_modul.css */
/* Only what the module really needs additionally.
   Bootstrap + Core-CSS already cover:
   Grid, Flexbox, Cards, Buttons, Forms, Tables */

/* Module-specific container */
.mm-container {
    max-width: 1200px;
}

/* Special upload zone */
.mm-upload-zone {
    border:        2px dashed var(--border-color);
    border-radius: var(--border-radius-card);
    padding:       2rem;
    text-align:    center;
    cursor:        pointer;
    transition:    all 0.2s;
}

.mm-upload-zone:hover {
    border-color: var(--abcona-blue);
    background:   var(--abcona-gray-card);
}

/* Status badge */
.mm-status-ok      { color: var(--status-green);  }
.mm-status-warning { color: var(--status-yellow); }
.mm-status-error   { color: var(--status-red);    }

5.5 Transition for Dark Mode

The core-theme.css already sets global transitions. For module CSS, no own transitions for colors are needed — unless for layout animations:

/* Already set globally in core-theme.css: */
* { transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; }

/* In the module only for layout animations: */
.mm-panel {
    transition: width 0.3s ease, opacity 0.2s ease;
}

5.6 Responsive in the Module

Mobile-first — Bootstrap Grid is sufficient for most cases. Own breakpoints only when Bootstrap is not enough:

/* Mobile (default — no media query needed) */
.mm-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

/* Tablet */
@media (min-width: 768px) {
    .mm-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}

/* Desktop */
@media (min-width: 1200px) {
    .mm-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
}
